h1: Ghana tourist visa from the UK
intro: Going to Ghana for a holiday or to visit family or friends? The Ghana tourist visa is applied for through the Ghana High Commission in London. We prepare your application, check your documents and submit it for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and a yellow fever certificate

sections.heading: What a Ghana tourist visa covers
sections.text: The Ghana tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends. It doesn't cover business meetings or work. For business trips, see our [Ghana business visa](/ghana-business-visa/) page.

sections.heading: Tourist visa or e-Tourist visa?
sections.text: Ghana also offers an [e-Tourist visa](/ghana-e-tourist-visa/), applied for online so you keep your passport. The High Commission visa suits travellers who prefer a visa in their passport or whose case doesn't fit the eVisa. We'll tell you which is best for your trip.

sections.heading: Yellow fever certificate
sections.text: Ghana requires all arriving travellers to show a valid yellow fever vaccination certificate. Get vaccinated at least 10 days before you travel, at a registered yellow fever centre.

sections.heading: Ghana tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Ghana tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/ghana) for Ghana.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Ghana tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Ghana tourist visa. You'll need an invitation letter from your host with a copy of their ID.

faqs.q: How long does a Ghana tourist visa take?
faqs.a: High Commission processing times vary. Allow several weeks, and longer around Christmas and festival periods.

faqs.q: Do I need a yellow fever certificate?
faqs.a: Yes. Ghana requires a valid yellow fever vaccination certificate for entry, and you'll need to upload it with your application.
